numinance.kinds.v1.AdapterBinding.jsonsc.description: AdapterBinding is one provider installation serving a port.

instance.description: instance is required: the configured instance of the provider (one provider may serve several, such as two CI servers).

provider.description: provider is required: the extension id of a provider of the port, which must resolve to a lockfile entry.
